usedFor: Cin7 Core holds sales, purchases and stock, and Calendly receives a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new sale is created” in Cin7 Core, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new sale is when a customer may want a call, and the action makes a booking link.

watchOut: “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly only creates a link, so a later step must deliver it.
